reason: Owner printings on post-load creators: PlayerDeckPool gains an optional display-only printings record (the seat's normalized printing rows plus a face-identity to lookup-name correspondence) and CompanionInfo gains an optional display-only printing (CR 203.1/206.1). An older server or peer silently drops both, so a declared companion put into hand, or a sideboard card brought in by a Wish or Learn effect, loses the owner's chosen printing while the viewer's toggle says it is shown (silent capability loss; defaults alone do not establish compatibility).
